en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large cobblestoned square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with arcades at ground level. In the background, a church tower rises above the rooftops. On the right side stands a large baroque fountain with statuary. A few pedestrians and a cyclist cross the nearly empty square. A handwritten-style caption along the bottom white margin identifies the square.
